notes: This is a reference list of supported placeholders (tokens) used across templates.
Your generator can replace {{TOKEN}} occurrences with values from intake/computed fields.

FAVICON_INITIALS: computed from BUSINESS_NAME — first letter of the first word plus first letter of the second word (uppercase). If only one word, use its first two letters (uppercase). Used in favicon.svg.
BUILD_DATE: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) for humans.txt Last update; set at bundle or deploy time.
PHONE_NUMBER: US/Canada display format (XXX) XXX-XXXX in visible copy and link text. PHONE_NUMBER_E164 (+1…) is for tel: hrefs and JSON-LD telephone only (see HTML templates).
